ACTION 26 OF 32 · PHASE 07

Launch one controlled campaign

Learn which customer message converts without waste.

WHEN TO DO THISWhen you can reliably answer and fulfill real enquiries.ESTIMATED WORK TIME1–2 weeks
↗
Your one job

Learn which customer message converts without waste.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Choose one buyer group, one offer and a clear call to action.

  2. 02

    For Meta test two distinct angles using authentic imagery; for Google use tightly relevant search terms with negative keywords.

  3. 03

    Track spend, qualified inquiries, follow-ups, bookings/revenue and margin where possible.

  4. 04

    Change one major variable at a time; compare outcomes over a meaningful sample instead of reacting to single-day noise.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Create a small controlled ad test for [OFFER] with [LOCATION], approved spend [BUDGET] and goal [BOOKING/LEAD]. Give two messages in Hook → Information → CTA format, exact landing page requirements, a lead tracker and a weekly scorecard. Include stop, adjust and scale criteria that account for small sample sizes and unit economics.
03

Finish with this

Campaign scorecard showing cost per qualified inquiry and bookings where measured.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Campaign has an approved budget cap
  • Real conversion recorded rather than just traffic
  • Follow-up ownership defined
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Spending more because impressions are cheap while bookings stay flat.

READY TO MOVE ON?

You can trace enquiries to their sources and estimate if acquisition makes commercial sense.
